title: UE is using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization

entities.name: Control Plane Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, handling different service types and conditions for sending SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to initiate control plane service request procedure.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message sent by MME to accept service request and complete the procedure.

entities.name: Control plane service type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of service request (mobile terminating/originating request).

entities.name: Active flag
entities.description: Flag in Control plane service type IE indicating UE's request for user plane activation.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: IE indicating status of EPS bearer contexts for synchronization between UE and MME.

entities.name: T3448 value
entities.description: IE containing timer value for control plane data back-off timer.

entities.name: T3448
entities.description: Timer for control plane data back-off, started when T3448 value IE is received in SERVICE ACCEPT.

entities.name: T3417
entities.description: Service request attempt timer, stopped upon successful completion of procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state entered by UE upon successful completion of service request procedure.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status synchronization needed
entities.description: Condition where MME needs to synchronize EPS bearer context status with UE.

entities.name: Local deactivation of EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Behavior where UE or MME deactivates EPS bearer contexts locally without peer-to-peer signaling.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated by UE sending CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains Control plane service type IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message contains active flag in Control plane service type IE.
CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message may contain EPS bearer context status IE.
When EPS bearer context status synchronization is needed, MME shall send SERVICE ACCEPT message.
SERVICE ACCEPT message may contain EPS bearer context status IE for synchronization.
SERVICE ACCEPT message may contain T3448 value IE when congestion control is activated.
Receipt of SERVICE ACCEPT with T3448 value IE causes UE to start timer T3448.
Successful completion of procedure stops timer T3417.
Successful completion of procedure causes UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED state.
Presence of EPS bearer context status IE triggers local deactivation of inconsistent bearer contexts.
